purpose: Teach: フェミニスト/思慮/恒常/親日/親睦/大局/同紙/領主

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、フェミニスト運動の戦後史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on postwar feminist movements, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Gentle confirmation rather than interrogation. Voice settles on her name. Steady, interested eye contact level.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、宗教家の思慮深さを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote mine on the thoughtfulness of religious figures.
lines.style: Straightforward, respectful. Clear delivery without hesitation. Young voice, earnest but not overplayed. Direct eye contact back.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 生態系の恒常性研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered ecosystem homeostasis in your research, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly curious pause before the question. Warm but measured. The tone of someone genuinely interested in seeing where this leads.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦前の親日派外国人を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on pro-Japanese foreign figures from the prewar period.
lines.style: Clear, measured response. No apology in the voice. Confident without being defensive. Meets her steady tone with her own steadiness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地域コミュニティの親睦活動を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you explored local community fellowship activities for your paper?
lines.style: Engaged but not leading. Natural conversational rhythm. A teacher genuinely tracking the thread of discussion. Slight uptick of interest in her voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、外交における大局観を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the broader diplomatic perspective in international relations.
lines.style: Steady, clear delivery. No filler or hedge words. Teenage voice but thoughtful, not rushed. Slight emphasis on the substance of her work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 同紙のスクープ記事を研究で扱いましたね
lines.en: You included investigative articles from that same publication in your research?
lines.style: Reflective, connecting-the-dots tone. Gentle curiosity, not accusation. Paced for genuine understanding. Open-ended, inviting clarification.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、中世領主の統治を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the governance of medieval feudal lords.
lines.style: Final response, clear and complete. Slight settling in the voice—the comfort of finishing. Authentic teenage earnestness, no performance. Quiet confidence at the close.
